name: New Balance Fresh Foam Lav v2 Court Shoe
description: The New Balance Fresh Foam Lav v2 pairs a plush Fresh Foam X midsole with a supportive internal heel counter for players who spend long sessions on hard courts. It is offered in wide (2E) and extra-wide (4E) widths and backed by a six-month outsole durability guarantee for heavy lateral movers.
care_instructions: Brush dirt off the outsole after play and wipe the upper with a damp cloth. Remove the insole to air dry. Do not machine wash or put in a dryer, as heat can warp the Fresh Foam X midsole.
